corpus.title: Annual Leave & Carry Forward Policy
corpus.content:
Section 1: Annual Leave Entitlement.
Full-time employees receive 20 paid annual leave days per calendar year.
Unused annual leave up to 5 days may be carried forward into Q1 of the next calendar year.
Employees should submit planned annual leave requests at least 3 working days in advance.

corpus.title: Sick & Casual Leave Policy
corpus.content:
Section 2: Sick and Casual Leave Rules.
Full-time employees receive 10 paid sick leave days and 10 paid casual leave days per calendar year.
A registered medical certificate is required after 2 consecutive sick leave days.
Casual leave cannot exceed 3 consecutive days without prior HR approval.

corpus.title: Probation and Working Hours Policy
corpus.content:
Section 3: Probation Period and Standard Working Hours.
The standard probation period for all full-time hires is 90 days (3 months).
Department managers and HR conduct a written confirmation review before day 85.
Standard office hours are 09:00 to 18:00 Monday through Friday with a 15-minute morning grace window.

corpus.title: Remote Work & Travel Allowance Policy
corpus.content:
Section 4: Remote Work Stipend & Outstation Travel Per Diem.
Approved hybrid and remote employees receive a monthly internet and ergonomics stipend of PKR 12,000.
Outstation business travel receives a daily meal per diem of PKR 3,500.

corpus.title: Maternity Leave & Statutory Protection
corpus.content:
Section 5: Maternity Leave Entitlement.
Female employees are entitled to 12 weeks (84 calendar days) of fully paid maternity leave — 6 weeks prior to delivery and 6 weeks post-delivery.
Maternity leave pay is disbursed at 100% of gross monthly salary.

corpus.title: Bimari Aur Salana Rukhsat Policy (Urdu)
corpus.content:
بیماری، سالانہ رخصت اور دفتری اوقات کار کی پالیسی:
ملازمین کو سالانہ 20 دن کی بامعاوضہ سالانہ چھٹی اور 10 دن کی بیماری کی چھٹی ملتی ہے۔
مسلسل 2 دن سے زیادہ بیماری کی چھٹی لینے پر میڈیکل سرٹیفکیٹ جمع کرانا لازمی ہے۔
دفتری اوقات کار صبح 9 بجے سے شام 6 بجے تک ہیں اور 15 منٹ کی گریس ٹائم رعایت دستیاب ہے۔

corpus.title: Confidential Executive Bonus Framework
corpus.content:
Section 9: Confidential Executive Bonus Pool.
CONFIDENTIAL_EXEC_BONUS_POOL equals 35% of annual base pay for C-level executive officers approved by the Board Compensation Committee.

corpus.title: IT Self-Service & Corporate VPN Reset Guide
corpus.content:
KB-IT-01: Corporate VPN Password & MFA Reset.
To reset your corporate VPN password, open the SSO Self-Service Portal at portal.acme.local, authenticate with your employee email, and select Reset VPN & MFA Token.
